ai_models_price_check.name: ai_models_price_check
ai_models_price_check.value: ("ai_models"."price_input_per_mtok" is null) = ("ai_models"."price_output_per_mtok" is null) and ("ai_models"."price_input_per_mtok" is null or ("ai_models"."price_input_per_mtok" >= 0 and "ai_models"."price_output_per_mtok" >= 0 and "ai_models"."price_source" is not null))

service_price_versions_qty_check.name: service_price_versions_qty_check
service_price_versions_qty_check.value: ("service_price_versions"."min_qty" is null or "service_price_versions"."min_qty" >= 1) and ("service_price_versions"."max_qty" is null or "service_price_versions"."min_qty" is null or "service_price_versions"."max_qty" > "service_price_versions"."min_qty")

services_qty_check.name: services_qty_check
services_qty_check.value: ("services"."min_qty" is null or "services"."min_qty" >= 1) and ("services"."max_qty" is null or "services"."max_qty" >= 1) and ("services"."min_qty" is null or "services"."max_qty" is null or "services"."max_qty" >= "services"."min_qty")

services_text_lengths_check.name: services_text_lengths_check
services_text_lengths_check.value: length("services"."name") between 3 and 120 and length("services"."description") <= 1000 and length("services"."instructions") <= 1000 and length("services"."internal_notes") <= 1000 and length("services"."fulfillment_notes") <= 1000 and length("services"."fulfillment_provider_ref") <= 40

deposits_status_reason_check.name: deposits_status_reason_check
deposits_status_reason_check.value: "deposits"."status_reason" is null or length("deposits"."status_reason") between 3 and 300

deposits_settled_check.name: deposits_settled_check
deposits_settled_check.value: "deposits"."status" not in ('settled', 'credited') or "deposits"."settled_at" is not null

order_events_status_check.name: order_events_status_check
order_events_status_check.value: ("order_events"."from_status" is null or "order_events"."from_status" in ('pending_review', 'queued', 'in_progress', 'partial', 'needs_customer_action', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'failed', 'refunded', 'rejected')) and ("order_events"."to_status" is null or "order_events"."to_status" in ('pending_review', 'queued', 'in_progress', 'partial', 'needs_customer_action', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'failed', 'refunded', 'rejected'))

generated.as:
case
          when status in ('pending_review', 'queued') then 'pending'
          when status in ('in_progress', 'partial') then 'processing'
          when status = 'needs_customer_action' then 'attention'
          when status = 'completed' then 'completed'
          else 'cancelled' end

orders_text_lengths_check.name: orders_text_lengths_check
orders_text_lengths_check.value: ("orders"."status_reason" is null or length("orders"."status_reason") between 3 and 500) and ("orders"."fulfillment_ref" is null or length("orders"."fulfillment_ref") between 2 and 80) and ("orders"."link" is null or length("orders"."link") <= 500)

providers_enable_check.name: providers_enable_check
providers_enable_check.value: not "providers"."enabled" or ("providers"."supplier_reviewed_at" is not null and "providers"."adapter" is not null and "providers"."archived_at" is null)

providers_text_check.name: providers_text_check
providers_text_check.value: char_length("providers"."name") between 2 and 80 and char_length("providers"."description") <= 500 and char_length("providers"."limitations") <= 500

referral_policies_ranges_check.name: referral_policies_ranges_check
referral_policies_ranges_check.value: "referral_policies"."min_spend_cents" >= 0 and "referral_policies"."qualifying_days" between 1 and 365 and "referral_policies"."hold_days" between 0 and 90 and "referral_policies"."min_orders" between 1 and 100

referral_rewards_approved_check.name: referral_rewards_approved_check
referral_rewards_approved_check.value: "referral_rewards"."status" not in ('approved', 'credited') or "referral_rewards"."approved_by" is not null

journal_entries_four_eyes_check.name: journal_entries_four_eyes_check
journal_entries_four_eyes_check.value: "journal_entries"."approved_by" is null or "journal_entries"."created_by" is null or "journal_entries"."approved_by" <> "journal_entries"."created_by"

ledger_accounts_wallet_check.name: ledger_accounts_wallet_check
ledger_accounts_wallet_check.value: "ledger_accounts"."code" not like 'wallet:%' or ("ledger_accounts"."type" = 'liability' and "ledger_accounts"."customer_id" is not null and not "ledger_accounts"."allow_negative")

social_connections_tokens_check.name: social_connections_tokens_check
social_connections_tokens_check.value: "social_connections"."status" <> 'disconnected' or ("social_connections"."access_token_ciphertext" is null and "social_connections"."refresh_token_ciphertext" is null)

social_posts_body_check.name: social_posts_body_check
social_posts_body_check.value: char_length("social_posts"."body") <= 5000 and ("social_posts"."title" is null or char_length("social_posts"."title") <= 100)

social_posts_scheduled_check.name: social_posts_scheduled_check
social_posts_scheduled_check.value: "social_posts"."status" <> 'scheduled' or ("social_posts"."scheduled_at" is not null and "social_posts"."approved_at" is not null)

digital_products_price_check.name: digital_products_price_check
digital_products_price_check.value: ("digital_products"."pricing" = 'paid' and "digital_products"."price_cents" between 1 and 100000000) or ("digital_products"."pricing" <> 'paid' and "digital_products"."price_cents" is null)
